message.content:
Based on the three UI screenshots of **ELASTICO** (a football analytics platform), here is an extreme detailed analysis of the design system:

---

## 1. EXACT COLOR PALETTE

### Background Hierarchy (Dark Theme - Primary Mode)
- **Primary Background (App Shell):** `#0B0E14` (near-black with slight blue undertone)
- **Secondary Background (Cards/Panels):** `#131820` or `#151A23` (dark charcoal, subtle elevation)
- **Tertiary Background (Hover/Active States):** `#1C2430` (slightly lighter charcoal)
- **Sidebar Background:** `#0F1219` (matches primary but with left border accent)
- **Input/Field Background:** `#1A2029` (slightly lighter than cards)

### Text Colors
- **Primary Text:** `#F1F5F9` (off-white, high contrast)
- **Secondary Text:** `#94A3B8` (muted slate blue-gray)
- **Tertiary/Muted Text:** `#64748B` (darker slate for timestamps, labels)
- **Disabled Text:** `#475569` (very dim)

### Accent & Semantic Colors
- **Brand Primary (Green):** `#10B981` / `#22C55E` (vibrant emerald for positive metrics, active states, "LIVE" badges)
- **Brand Secondary (Blue):** `#3B82F6` / `#60A5FA` (for Man City/home team data, links, primary actions)
- **Danger/Error (Red):** `#EF4444` / `#DC2626` (for Arsenal/away team data, negative values, alerts)
- **Warning (Amber/Yellow):** `#F59E0B` (for "Draw" predictions, caution states)
- **Purple/Violet:** `#8B5CF6` (for AI insights icons, model confidence indicators)
- **Cyan/Teal:** `#06B6D4` (for specific chart lines, secondary accents)

### Border & Divider Colors
- **Subtle Borders:** `rgba(255,255,255,0.06)` or `#1E293B`
- **Card Borders:** `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)` (barely visible)
- **Divider Lines:** `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`
- **Focus Rings:** `rgba(16,185,129,0.4)` (green glow for inputs)

### Chart-Specific Colors
- **Home Win (Green):** `#4ADE80`
- **Draw (Yellow):** `#FBBF24`
- **Away Win (Blue):** `#60A5FA`
- **Gradient Overlays:** Semi-transparent overlays on dark backgrounds for depth

---

## 2. TYPOGRAPHY SYSTEM

### Font Family
- **Primary:** **Inter** (or similar geometric sans-serif like SF Pro Display, Plus Jakarta Sans)
- **Monospace/Data:** **JetBrains Mono** or **Roboto Mono** (for numbers, percentages, time codes)
- **Characteristics:** Clean, slightly condensed, excellent x-height for dashboard density

### Font Weights
- **Light (300):** Used sparingly for large display numbers (e.g., "24,847")
- **Regular (400):** Body text, descriptions, table content
- **Medium (500):** Sidebar labels, card titles, navigation items
- **Semibold (600):** Section headers, metric labels, button text
- **Bold (700):** Key statistics (scores, percentages), active states

### Type Scale (Approximate)
- **Display/Hero (28-32px):** Main dashboard title "Dashboard", match scores ("2 - 1")
- **H1 (20-22px):** Card headers ("Live Matches", "AI Prediction Overview")
- **H2 (16-18px):** Subsection headers, player names, team names
- **Body (14px):** Standard text, table rows, descriptions
- **Caption (12px):** Timestamps ("2 min ago"), metadata, axis labels
- **Micro (10-11px):** Badge text, tiny stats, legend items

### Text Treatment
- **Numbers:** Tabular figures (monospaced) for alignment in tables
- **Tracking:** Slightly increased letter-spacing (-0.01em to 0.02em) for uppercase labels
- **Line Height:** 1.4-1.5 for body, 1.2 for dense data displays

---

## 3. LAYOUT STRUCTURE

### Grid System
- **Sidebar Width:** Fixed **260px** (collapsible to ~64px icon-only mode as seen in screenshot 2)
- **Content Area:** Fluid remaining width with max-width ~1920px
- **Gutter/Gap:** **24px** between major sections, **16px** between cards within a section
- **Padding:**
  - Content area padding: **32px** horizontal, **24px** vertical
  - Card padding: **20-24px** internal padding
  - Sidebar item padding: **12px 16px**

### Card Architecture
- **Border Radius:** **8px** (standard), **12px** (featured cards), **6px** (compact elements)
- **Shadows:** Subtle `0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)` for elevation, or flat design with border only
- **Header Pattern:** Title left-aligned, "View All" link right-aligned in secondary color (`#94A3B8`)
- **Footer Pattern:** Optional, used for pagination or action bars

### Dashboard Grid Layouts
- **Stats Row:** 6-column grid (equal width) for KPI cards at top
- **Main Content:** 3-column layout (40% | 30% | 30%) or (50% | 25% | 25%)
- **Match Detail:** Asymmetric split (60% main content | 40% sidebar widgets)

### Responsive Behavior (Implied)
- Collapsible sidebar with icon-only state
- Horizontal scroll for wide tables
- Stacked cards on smaller viewports (implied by flexible grids)

---

## 4. COMPONENT STYLES (EXACT SPECIFICATIONS)

### A. Navigation/Sidebar
- **Background:** `#0F1219` with subtle right-border `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`
- **Active Item:** 
  - Background: `#1E293B` (dark blue-gray)
  - Left border indicator: **3px solid #10B981** (green)
  - Text: White (#FFFFFF)
  - Icon: Green tinted
- **Inactive Item:** 
  - Hover background: `rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`
  - Text: `#94A3B8`
- **Collapsible Sections:** Chevron icons (down/right rotation), indented children (**16px** indent)
- **User Profile (Bottom):** Avatar circle + Name + Role badge, separated by divider

### B. KPI Cards (Top Stats Row)
- **Layout:** Icon (left) + Label (top) + Value (large) + Change indicator (bottom)
- **Icon Container:** Circle **40x40px**, background `rgba(255,255,255,0.05)`, icon colored by category
- **Value Typography:** **24-28px**, Bold, Monospace feel
- **Change Indicator:** 
  - Positive: `+12.5%` in green with up-arrow
  - Negative: Red with down-arrow
  - Neutral: Gray
- **Subtle top border:** Sometimes 2px colored line indicating category (green for profit, etc.)

### C. Data Tables (Live Matches, Predictions)
- **Row Height:** **48-52px** (comfortable touch target)
- **Hover State:** Background `rgba(255,255,255,0.03)`
- **Borders:** Bottom borders only, `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.05)`
- **Team Rows:** 
  - Logo (24x24px circle) + Team name (left)
  - Numeric stats center/right aligned
  - Color coding: Red numbers for goals/conceded, white for neutral
- **Zebra Striping:** Very subtle alternating rows (every other row slightly lighter)

### D. Buttons
- **Primary Button:**
  - Background: `#10B981` (green) or gradient `linear-gradient(135deg, #10B981, #059669)`
  - Text: White, font-weight 500
  - Padding: **10px 20px**
  - Border-radius: **6px**
  - Hover: Brightness 110%, subtle shadow lift
- **Secondary/Ghost Button:**
  - Border: `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.15)`
  - Background: Transparent
  - Text: `#E2E8F0`
  - Hover: Background `rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`
- **Icon Buttons (Top Bar):**
  - Size: **36x36px**
  - Border-radius: **8px**
  - Hover: Background `rgba(255,255,255,0.1)`
  - Notification badge: Red dot **8px** or number pill

### E. Badges & Tags
- **Status Badges (LIVE):**
  - Pill shape, full rounded (border-radius: **999px**)
  - Background: `rgba(16,185,129,0.15)` (green tint)
  - Text: `#34D399` (bright green)
  - Animated pulse dot (optional, implied by "LIVE" status)
- **Confidence Badges:**
  - High: Green background/tint
  - Medium: Yellow/Amber
  - Low: Red
- **Role Badges ("Elite Analyst", "Pro Analyst"):**
  - Small text (**10-11px**)
  - Background: `rgba(59,130,246,0.15)` (blue tint)
  - Text: `#60A5FA`

### F. Inputs & Search
- **Search Bar:**
  - Background: `#1A2029`
  - Border: `1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)`
  - Border-radius: **8px**
  - Placeholder: `#64748B`
  - Icon: Left-aligned search icon (magnifying glass) in muted color
  - Keyboard shortcut hint: Right-aligned gray pill "⌘K"
- **Dropdown Selectors:**
  - Similar styling to inputs
  - Chevron down icon on right
  - Custom dropdown menu with dark background `#1C2430`

### G. Charts & Data Visualization
- **Donut/Ring Charts:**
  - Thickness: **20-24px** stroke
  - Center text: Large statistic with label below
  - Colors: Segmented (Green/Yellow/Blue for outcomes)
  - Legend: Right-aligned small dots with labels
- **Line Charts:**
  - Stroke width: **2-3px**
  - No fill (or very subtle gradient fill to bottom)
  - Dot markers: **4-6px** circles at data points (white fill, colored stroke)
  - Grid lines: Very faint horizontal lines `rgba(255,255,255,0.04)`
  - Axes: Labels in **11px** muted text
- **Bar Charts:**
  - Rounded tops (border-radius: **4px** on top corners only)
  - Gradient fills or solid colors
  - Spacing: **4-6px** between bars
- **Heatmaps (Player Position):**
  - Soccer pitch background (green/dark overlay)
  - Intensity dots with glow effect (yellow/red hotspots)
  - Hexagonal or circular binning

### H. Match Scoreboard Component
- **Container:** Dark card with centered layout
- **Team Logos:** **56x56px** or **64x64px** circular with subtle shadow
- **Score Numbers:** **48-56px**, Bold, White
- **VS Label:** Small, uppercase, tracked out, muted color
- **Time Indicator:** "87'" in red/green depending on status
- **Possession Bar:** Thin progress bar (height **6-8px**), segmented colors (Blue vs Red)

### I. Player Cards & Avatars
- **Avatar Sizes:**
  - Tiny: **24px** (tables)
  - Small: **36px** (lists)
  - Medium: **48px** (profile headers)
  - Large: **96-120px** (player profile hero)
- **Shape:** Circle with **2px solid** border matching team color or white
- **Status Indicators:** Online dot (green) bottom-right on avatar
- **Player Hero Image:** Full bleed background image with gradient overlay (black transparent to solid dark)

---

## 5. DARK THEME VS LIGHT THEME SPECIFICITIES

**Note:** Screenshots show primarily **Dark Theme** (default). Light theme is referenced in Settings (Screenshot 3).

### Dark Theme Characteristics (Dominant)
- **Surface Layers:** Uses depth through darkness levels rather than shadows
  - Level 0: `#0B0E14` (base)
  - Level 1: `#131820` (cards)
  - Level 2: `#1C2430` (hover/elevated)
  - Level 3: `#263040` (modals/dropdowns)
- **Contrast Ratio:** High contrast (WCAG AAA compliant for text)
- **Vibrancy:** Accent colors appear more neon/vibrant against dark backgrounds
- **Glassmorphism:** Subtle use of backdrop-blur on modals or floating panels (implied by modern aesthetic)

### Light Theme (Referenced in Settings)
- Likely inversion:
  - Background: `#F8FAFC` or `#FFFFFF`
  - Cards: `#FFFFFF` with `#E2E8F0` borders
  - Text: Inverted hierarchy (`#0F172A` primary, `#64748B` secondary)
  - Shadows become primary elevation tool instead of background variation

---

## 6. ICONOGRAPHY SYSTEM

### Style
- **Library:** **Lucide Icons**, **Heroicons**, or **Phosphor Icons** (consistent stroke-based style)
- **Weight:** **Stroke width 1.5px or 2px** (outline style, not filled)
- **Size Variants:**
  - Navigation: **20x20px**
  - Action buttons: **18x18px**
  - Inline with text: **16x16px**
  - Large feature icons: **32-40px**
- **Color Behavior:**
  - Default: `currentColor` (inherits text color usually `#94A3B8`)
  - Active/Accent: Specific semantic colors (Green for success, Blue for info)
  - Two-tone: Some icons use opacity variations (e.g., 60% and 100%)

### Specific Icon Usage
- **Navigation:** Home, LayoutGrid (Dashboard), Trophy (Matches), Brain (Predictions), Radio (Live), Chart (Analysis), Users (Players), Building (Teams), ArrowsOutCardinal (Compare), Swords (Tactics), Sparkles (AI Assistant), Gamepad2 (Simulator), Vote (Vote), Share2 (Social), Bookmark, Award, Monitor (System), Shield (Admin), Settings (Gear)
- **Actions:** Search, Bell (Notifications), Headphones (Support), Refresh, Maximize, MoreVertical (Kebab), ExternalLink, Download, Filter, Calendar (Date picker), ChevronDown/Right/Left (navigation)
- **Status:** CheckCircle (success/green), AlertCircle (warning/yellow), XCircle (error/red), Info (blue), Zap (AI insights), Clock (history/time), Flame (hot/live)
- **Sports-specific:** Soccer ball, Whistle, Timer, Field/Pitch (tactical views), TrendingUp/Down (odds movement)

---

## 7. OVERALL DESIGN LANGUAGE & AESTHETIC

### Design Philosophy
**"Precision Analytics"** – The interface conveys:
- **Data Density:** Information-rich without clutter (Edward Tufte principles applied to sports data)
- **Trust & Authority:** Dark mode suggests professional/trading terminal aesthetic (like Bloomberg Terminal meets modern SaaS)
- **Real-time Urgency:** Use of red/green for live data, pulsing indicators, timestamp precision ("2 sec ago")

### Visual Rhythm
- **Consistent 8px Grid System:** All spacing multiples of 4 or 8
- **Visual Hierarchy:** Clear F-pattern scanning; large numbers draw eye first, then charts, then details
- **Breathing Room:** Generous whitespace around complex charts prevents cognitive overload

### Micro-interactions (Implied)
- **Hover Lifts:** Cards subtly translate Y(-2px) on hover with shadow increase
- **Smooth Transitions:** 200-300ms ease-out for state changes
- **Loading States:** Skeleton screens with shimmer animation (gray pulses)
- **Data Refresh:** Subtle fade transitions when numbers update live

### Unique ELASTICO Signatures
1. **The "S-Curve" Logo:** Stylized infinity loop or elastic curve in green/white (seen in header)
2. **Confidence Meters:** Circular progress rings with percentage centers (signature component)
3. **Dual-team Color Coding:** Consistent use of Blue (home) vs Red (away) throughout all visualizations
4. **AI Integration UI:** Distinctive purple/glowing accents for AI-generated content vs human data
5. **Pitch Visualizations:** Tactical diagrams with glowing player positions (neon-on-dark effect)

### Accessibility Considerations (Observed)
- **Color Blind Safety:** Patterns/textures accompany colors (e.g., dashed lines, shapes)
- **Touch Targets:** Minimum 44px for interactive elements
- **Focus States:** Visible ring outlines (green glow) for keyboard navigation
- **Text Scaling:** Relative units allowing zoom to 150%

### Technical Implementation Notes
- **Framework Appearance:** React/Next.js with Tailwind CSS (utility class naming patterns visible in structure)
- **Chart Library:** Recharts, Chart.js, or custom SVG implementations (smooth curves suggest D3.js or Recharts)
- **Animation Library:** Framer Motion likely used for micro-interactions
- **State Management:** Real-time WebSocket connections implied by "Live" indicators and "2 sec ago" timestamps

This design system represents a **premium B2B/B2C hybrid** product targeting serious football analysts, bettors, and enthusiasts who value data accuracy presented with **terminal-style efficiency** and **modern app aesthetics**.
